boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Stony Brook University
boards.description: Ten currently listed campus dining destinations with evening or midnight availability; check the official dining page before going because schedules may change.

cards.title: East Side Dining
cards.subtitle: East campus dining hall
cards.notes: Use the dine-in hall for a campus meal late in the evening; confirm the day’s schedule on SBU Eats before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining hall with service listed through midnight on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists East Side Dine-In open 7:30 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday–Friday and 9 a.m.–11 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Monday–Friday until 12 a.m.; Saturday–Sunday until 11 p.m. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Emporium Market
cards.subtitle: East Side Dining retail market
cards.notes: Stop at the East Side retail market for food or packaged items in the evening, then verify the current closing time before leaving.
cards.short_summary: East Side’s market is listed through midnight on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Emporium Market open 8 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday–Friday and until 11 p.m. Saturday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Monday–Friday until 12 a.m.; Saturday–Sunday until 11 p.m. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: West Side Dining
cards.subtitle: West campus dining hall
cards.notes: Plan a late dinner in the West Side dine-in hall, and use the live dining-hours page to confirm service before heading there.
cards.short_summary: A West campus dining hall listed through midnight on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists West Side Dine-In open 7:30 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday–Friday and 9 a.m.–11 p.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Monday–Friday until 12 a.m.; Saturday–Sunday until 11 p.m. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Market at West Side
cards.subtitle: West Side Dining retail market
cards.notes: Use this West Side market when you need an evening food stop; check the official schedule for the applicable weekday or weekend time.
cards.short_summary: The West Side retail market is listed through midnight Monday through Friday.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Market at West Side open 10 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday–Friday and until 11 p.m. Saturday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Monday–Friday until 12 a.m.; Saturday–Sunday until 11 p.m. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Subway at Roth Food Court
cards.subtitle: Roth Food Court
cards.notes: Order at the Roth Food Court Subway for a late meal, checking campus dining updates first if your visit falls near a holiday or break.
cards.short_summary: A Roth Food Court counter listed until midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Subway at Roth Food Court open until 12 a.m. Monday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed closing time: 12 a.m. daily. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Smash n’ Shake
cards.subtitle: Roth Food Court
cards.notes: Choose this Roth Food Court counter for an evening order; check the official hours page for the day, particularly on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A Roth Food Court counter listed until midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Smash n’ Shake open until 12 a.m. Monday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed closing time: 12 a.m. daily. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Popeyes at Roth Food Court
cards.subtitle: Roth Food Court
cards.notes: Head to the Roth Food Court counter for a later dinner window, but verify operations directly with SBU Eats before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Roth Food Court counter with listed service until 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Popeyes at Roth Food Court open until 10:30 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Current listed closing time: 10:30 p.m. daily. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Cocina Fresca
cards.subtitle: East Side Dining retail
cards.notes: Use this East Side retail counter for a weekday late meal; confirm the date because its official listing shows shorter Friday service and weekend closure.
cards.short_summary: An East Side counter listed until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Cocina Fresca open 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, until 7 p.m. Friday, and closed weekends.
cards.access_notes: Current listed late hours: Monday–Thursday until 10 p.m.; Friday until 7 p.m.; closed weekends. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Wicked Wingz
cards.subtitle: East Side Dining retail
cards.notes: Make this an early-week evening food stop at East Side, and consult SBU Eats first because Friday and weekend service differ from weekday hours.
cards.short_summary: An East Side counter listed until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Wicked Wingz open 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, until 7 p.m. Friday, and closed weekends.
cards.access_notes: Current listed late hours: Monday–Thursday until 10 p.m.; Friday until 7 p.m.; closed weekends. Hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Halal NY
cards.subtitle: East Side Dining retail
cards.notes: Visit this East Side retail counter for a weekday dinner option; review the official hours page before going, especially late in the week.
cards.short_summary: An East Side counter listed until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU Eats lists Halal NY open 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, until 7 p.m. Friday, and closed weekends.
cards.access_notes: Current listed late hours: Monday–Thursday until 10 p.m.; Friday until 7 p.m.; closed weekends. Hours are subject to change.
